comments.body:
Thanks, Gudebuddha!

A friend of mine told me that the day of the week influencieates in the loot of these chests. Anyone knows if that is true?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: That sounds extremely unlikely, and I cannot recall hearing or reading of anything like that being implemented on other servers (and there is no indication of it being done on Maris either). It appears to simply be based on a % drop table, nothing more.
